svg.text: DI BOARD (optional) - balanced XLR out (20 x 23 holes)
Component side. Copper strips run left to right. Red crosses: cut the strip at that hole.
main board J10a: the OUT line
LIFT toggle; its other side to XLR pin 1
5 cuts. U2 in an 8-pin socket, notch at the top.
C11, C12: + towards the XLR. C10: + towards U2.
Optional: leave the board out and nothing else changes.
